usageNotes: Use this to update an existing Active Directory realm configuration in Proxmox Datacenter Manager — for example, to rotate the bind password, switch to LDAPS, add a fallback server, or adjust user-sync defaults. The realm must already exist (use the POST endpoint to create it). Requires the `Realm.Allocate` privilege on `/access/domains`; pass the `digest` field from the current config to guard against concurrent overwrites.

examples.summary: Upgrade an AD realm to LDAPS, add a fallback server, and map LDAP mail/givenName/sn attributes to PDM user fields

tips: Use the `delete` array to explicitly clear optional fields (e.g. `["server2","comment"]`) rather than sending an empty string, which may not unset them.
When switching from `ldap` to `ldaps` or `ldap+starttls`, also set `verify: true` and supply `capath` if the DC cert is signed by an internal CA — otherwise the sync will fail TLS verification.
The `digest` field (SHA-256 of the current config) enables optimistic locking; retrieve it from `get_config_access_ad_realm` before writing to avoid silently stomping a concurrent change.

The `password` field is write-only — it does not appear in GET responses; always re-supply it on updates if the bind account credentials have not changed, or the stored password will be cleared on some PDM versions.
User sync does not run automatically after this call; trigger a sync separately via the sync endpoint if you want immediate attribute propagation.
